pr_title: [backport v2.7-branch] soc: arm: stm32 mcus should execute stm32_power_init in PRE_KERNEL_1
pr_body:
soc: arm: stm32 mcus should execute stm32_power_init in PRE_KERNEL_1

Change the stm32_power_init to be executed PRE_KERNEL_1
for all the devices with the low power mode (power.c)
When GPIO and UART are not yet up and running.
includes the soc/arm/st_stm32/stm32u5/power.c

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/42915

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu <francois.ramu@st.com>
